Metadata.title: BookHive
Metadata.description: Search the catalog, check availability, and manage your loans, holds and fines online.

Home.heroSubtitle: Search the library catalog, see what's on the shelf right now, and reserve books before you visit.
Home.subjectsSubtitle: Organised by the Dewey Decimal Classification, just like our shelves.
Home.joinText: Apply online in a few minutes. Once approved, your digital library card is ready on your phone.

availability.title: Check availability
availability.text: See how many copies are on the shelf and exactly where to find them.

reserve.title: Reserve books
reserve.text: All copies out? Join the queue and we'll tell you when it's your turn.

renew.title: Renew from home
renew.text: See your due dates and renew loans without coming to the desk.

pay.title: Pay fines online
pay.text: Pay by card, eZ Cash or mCash and get a receipt by email.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.description: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the library.

Header.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, author or ISBN

StaffNav.label: Staff console
StaffNav.lookupPlaceholder: Member no, name, NIC or barcode

AccountHome.title: My account
AccountHome.description: Your loans, holds and fines will appear here.

StaffHome.title: Dashboard
StaffHome.description: Today's checkouts, returns, overdue items and pending approvals will appear here.

AdminHome.title: Overview
AdminHome.description: Library rules, staff accounts, reports and audit logs will be managed here.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to see your loans, holds and fines.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Then apply for library membership to start borrowing.
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
register.checkEmailText: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address, then log in.

verify.successText: Your account is ready. You can log in now.
verify.invalidText: It may have been used already. If you confirmed your email before, just log in.
verify.expiredText: Use "Forgot your password?" to get a new link: it confirms your email too.
verify.missingText: Open the link from the email we sent you.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please confirm your email first: open the link we sent you.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes, or reset your password.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Please contact the library.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach BookHive. Check your connection and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: BookHive is taking too long to answer. Please try again.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead?
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: This password is too easy to guess. Please choose a less common one.
errors.PASSWORD_CONTAINS_EMAIL: Your password must not contain your email address.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.phone: Enter a Sri Lankan number like 0771234567.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sentText: If {email} has a BookHive account, we've sent it a link. It works for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You'll be logged out on all your devices.
reset.doneText: You can log in with your new password now.

invite.title: Welcome to BookHive
invite.subtitle: Choose a password to activate your staff account.
invite.doneText: Log in with your email and the password you just chose.
invite.expiredText: Ask an administrator to send you a new invitation.

setPassword.invalidText: It may have been used already, or a newer link was sent.
setPassword.missingText: Open the link from the email we sent you.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your details and the language the library uses with you.
profile.emailHint: Your email can't be changed here. Ask the library if you need to change it.
profile.languageHint: The website and the library's emails use this language.

password.title: Change password
password.description: After the change you stay logged in here, and your other devices are logged out.
password.newHint: At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been logged out.
